out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: She repeatedly describes shifting/stepping "up and to the right" of her physical body (both NDE periods), including while in the hospital room next to her mother.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Enveloped in "complete love"; free from pain and fear.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Described as a "black spiraling tunnel" that she was "being drawn into"; she opened her eyes and "snapped" back.

arrival.other_being_detail: Shadow/human-like silhouetted forms around her; later interpreted as relatives/friends/soul group and guardian angels; also sensed an all-encompassing divine presence.

environment.environment_other_detail: First NDE: darkness with a distant warm glowing light silhouetting forms; described as a "holding area" like "train station". Second NDE: wooded area and flowering field with intensely bright greens and vivid multicolored wildflowers; blue sky; rode on a large "mythical" beast through fields.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Also understood she needed to return to her life/family/friends; and had to prepare for her baby's impending death.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: She frames a purpose to share/teach from her experiences, and to live according to her "plan"; also felt driven toward goals after the first NDE.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Two periods: (1) 1995 emergency surgery while ~5 months pregnant; she reports she "coded" and BP bottomed out. (2) 2010 complications after laparoscopic surgery leading to sepsis/septic shock and multiple surgeries; she describes multiple NDE-like "visits" over ~3 weeks.

person_demographics.nationality_ethnicity: Cherokee heritage (reported by a reader); American Indian Cherokee heritage mentioned.
person_demographics.religious_background_detail: Methodist church mentioned; she describes being unsure about the Bible and whether God existed.
person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Skeptical/uncertain belief; feared being "too much of a sinner" to be allowed into heaven during septic crisis.
person_demographics.occupation: Airline employee/management; trainer; martial arts and fitness instructor (as described).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Repeated "fugue state" visits during sepsis; riding on a "mythical" animal; "holding area" metaphor (train station).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experiences occurred as multiple episodes: first NDE emphasized OBE/holding area/light/relatives and return; later episodes included vivid nature realm and a separate brief black tunnel episode.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Multiple repeated episodes/"visits" over ~3 weeks during second illness; only two episodes remembered clearly.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Repeated waking "fugue" conversations with unseen beings while apparently awake in hospital; consistent spatial sense of the other realm being "up and to the right"; riding a large "mythical" beast in an afterlife-like field.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I felt as if I had just taken a short step up and to the right of me from my physical body."; "I felt like I was in some sort of holding area... like I was just in the train station waiting for my train to arrive."; "I immediately began going through a black spiraling tunnel... I was scared... I made myself come back to reality."; "the love I felt came from (my) God!"
